decision: Retain G as technical research support. Do not advance it to manuscript/formalization as one of the ten substantial results. No exact duplicate found; no worldwide novelty certificate.

Classical tree Green cut decomposition, Pareto-to-Poisson limit and finite-rank trace continuity with three cutoffs.

review_qualifications: G does provide a distributional inverse-gap limit through the norm of its random limit operator. It does not provide an explicit closed-form norm CDF. The review phrase excluding a law for the norm must be read with this distinction.
ADN endpoint definitions/coarea and the one-dimensional Faggionato template are antecedent operations, not a cited theorem directly implying all of G.
The unit-resistance comparison concerns the bridge part at M*sqrt(N) scale. Cyclic blocks cannot simply be discarded at that scale.
Unread CRT cutting/pruning papers are not evidence supporting this verdict. No universal decorated-family extension is asserted.
validation: 29 external inputs and five review payloads authenticated under terminal seal. Independent exact-arithmetic receipt reproduced byte-for-byte. Full 134-file candidate independently authenticated through proof inventory. Candidate and both reviews unchanged.
finite_check_limits: 40 trees, selected-child identities at N=3,5,7,9,11, 61 preorder examples and nested-cut arithmetic do not certify any asymptotic theorem.
